## 📘 About the Project
**QuizGenius** is an **AI-powered Quiz Management System** designed to automate quiz generation, management, and performance tracking.  
It uses **OpenAI’s GPT model** to dynamically generate questions based on selected categories and difficulty levels.  

💡 **Core Idea:** Simplify quiz creation and enhance learning through intelligent automation and adaptive feedback.

## 🎯 Features
✅ User Registration, Login & Profile Management  
✅ AI-Generated Questions using OpenAI GPT  
✅ Category & Difficulty-Based Quiz Generation  
✅ Real-time Scoring and Performance Dashboard  
✅ Personalized Quiz Preferences  
✅ Session-Based Authentication  
✅ Responsive UI with Bootstrap  
✅ Secure Environment Variable Management
